Date: 2026-12-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Partner proving ground request: scope and timeline

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — Catalyst Systems is putting together a short "proving ground" to validate Redwood Inference as a standard inference runtime we can recommend to our consulting engagements. High level objectives: 
- Reduce model inference cost on batch scoring for a 3-month pilot
- Validate private deployment with VPC+KMS for regulated clients
- Exercise rollout & canary behaviors for multi-model routing

Target timeline: intake + onboarding week of Dec 20, technical validation in Jan, small pilot with one customer in Feb.

Constraints / asks:
- We need a sandbox with realistic latency traces and a test corpus (PII scrubbed)
- Expected concurrency during validation ~40–60 qps; peak bursts possibly higher
- SOC2 evidence for operations (AICPA report) — procurement will ask for it

I've attached our short requirements doc (Catalyst_Onboarding_Requirements_v1.pdf). Can we do a quick intake call this week to align owners and get an initial SOW in motion? Devon Kramer (cc) will drive procurement.

Thanks,
Lisa
Sr. alliances lead | Catalyst Systems

On Mon, Dec 13, 2026 at 10:03 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene — can you flag any immediate blockers (KMS/HSM requirements or on-prem constraints) after reviewing the attached?

Thanks — reviewed the requirements doc quickly. A few technical notes / asks from SE side:
- For private VPC deployment we need: CIDR range, peering or private link preference, and KMS key ARN (we can support customer-managed keys).
- Concurrency: 40–60 qps is fine for a sandbox; please confirm average sequence length and expected token output rate (this affects memory footprint per replica).
- Test data: we require a scrubbed test corpus and a small representative prompt set for quality checks (we can provide a template)

Suggested validation plan (short):
1) Environment spin-up (48h): private sandbox + test tokens + telemetry hooks
2) Smoke tests (24h): basic routing, KV-cache warmup, prefix caching checks
3) Load & canary test (48–72h): step-up to target 60 qps, validate latency percentiles and fallback behavior
4) Quality eval: run 500 prompt set against two model variants and compare regressions

I'll prepare an "Integration Recipe" (short MD) and a checklist. Proposed workshop slots: Dec 21 or Dec 22 (60 minutes) to walk the team through the sandbox.

Attachment: Integration_Recipe_stub.md (will post in Drive)

—Irene
